description: Points one hostname of a shop's domain (for example www or book) at the shop's Seascape website or booking page, served through Cloudflare for SaaS. It adds a single CNAME to Seascape's fixed custom-hostname target and contains no variables. Apply it with the host parameter set. hostRequired is true because a CNAME cannot sit at a zone apex; on Cloudflare, which flattens a CNAME at the apex, the service provider may apply it with an empty host.
